title: Meta Web Measurement Data Extraction
completedHtml: Thank you for completing the data entry

elements.name: 2-q-p0-papertype
elements.title: Select which papers are available to select

elements.name: 6-q-p1-meta-3-metadatadetails
elements.title: Explain the issue with the metadata

elements.name: 8-q-p1-major-1-maintopic
elements.title: What is the main topic of the paper?

elements.name: 9-q-p1-major-2-measurementtype
elements.title: What is the type of the automated measurement?

elements.name: 10-q-p1-major-3-noactiveconf
elements.title: Does the paper really not contain any active Web Measurement?

elements.name: 11-q-p1-major-4-noactiveconffinal
elements.title: Confirm that the paper does not contain an active measurement
elements.description: Now you can click complete at the page bottom to complete

elements.name: 12-q-p1-major-5-datasetsource
elements.title: What is the source of the dataset?

elements.name: 14-q-p1-major-7-crawlpercentage
elements.title: How important is the measurement/crawl for the paper?

elements.name: 15-q-p1-major-8-crawlpurpose
elements.title: What is the main purpose of the measurement/crawl?

elements.name: 16-q-p1-major-9-multicrawl
elements.title: Does the paper perform multiple crawls/measurements?

elements.name: 17-q-p2-dataset-website-1-list
elements.title: From which list are the visited sites coming from?

elements.name: 18-q-p2-dataset-website-2-subsetsize
elements.title: How many unique sites (eTLD+1) were visited?
elements.description: If there are multiple measurements: take the largest and add details

elements.name: 21-q-p2-dataset-website-4-optout
elements.title: Was there an opt-out list of sites/servers? (e.g., full IP ranges ignored that do not want to contribute to the research)

elements.name: 22-q-p2-dataset-website-5-exclusion
elements.title: Were there any other exclusion criteria for websites (e.g., pornographic websites)?
elements.description: For invalid/not-reachable domains use the other question later down below

elements.name: 23-q-p2-dataset-webpage-1-starting
elements.title: What was the starting page?
elements.description: How are the domains from the list converted to URLs?

elements.name: 25-q-p2-dataset-webpage-3-internalselection
elements.title: How were the internal pages selected?

elements.name: 26-q-p2-dataset-webpage-4-internalsize
elements.title: How many internal pages per site?
elements.description: Put -1 if NA (e.g., bfs several depth levels)

elements.name: 28-q-p2-dataset-webpage-5-internallock
elements.title: Was there a same-site lock or similar for the crawl?

elements.name: 30-q-p2-setup-implementation-1-name
elements.title: What is the name of the crawling tech?
elements.placeholder: OpenWPM, crawlee, curl, playwright-custom, puppeteer-custom, requests-custom, unclear-custom, unclear, ....

elements.name: 31-q-p2-setup-implementation-2-browserbased
elements.title: Is the crawler browser-based?
elements.description: If there are multiple measurements, does at least one measurement use a browser?

elements.name: 32-q-p2-setup-implementation-3-automation
elements.title: What is the browser automation mode?

elements.name: 36-q-p2-setup-implementation-6-browserinstrumentation
elements.title: What kind of browser instrumentation was used?

elements.name: 37-q-p2-setup-implementation-7-browserext
elements.title: Were there any browser extensions installed?
elements.description: If not reported: default to no

elements.name: 38-q-p2-setup-implementation-8-headless
elements.title: Was the crawl headless or headfull?

elements.name: 41-q-p2-setup-implementation-11-othersettings
elements.title: Any other browser settings to report?

elements.name: 42-q-p2-setup-implementation-12-crawlertype
elements.title: Is the crawler custom-code or a finished crawler?
elements.description:
Custom-code (can use libraries such as playwright)
Finished crawler: crawlee, scrapee, OpenWMP, wget, ...

elements.name: 43-q-p2-setup-implementation-13-crawleradjustments
elements.title: Were there any crawling tech extensions or adjustments to the crawling tech described/mentioned?

elements.name: 45-q-p2-setup-implementation-15-botevasion
elements.title: Was any bot evasion reported? (static, e.g., stealth plugin, real user-agents)

elements.name: 48-q-p2-setup-env-2-ip
elements.title: Which type of IP was used?

elements.name: 51-q-p2-setup-env-5-time
elements.title: Was the time (period) of the crawl mentioned? (at least year)
elements.commentPlaceholder: E.g., from Date to Date (copy text from paper)

elements.name: p-setup-1-setup
elements.title: Setup (before visiting one URL of interest)

elements.name: 52-q-p2-setup-1-state
elements.title: Is state accumulated or deleted/fresh profile?

elements.name: 53-q-p2-setup-2-statedeletion
elements.title: How often is the state deleted?

elements.name: 55-q-p2-setup-4-addactions
elements.title: Is any other non-trivial setup done?
elements.description: Interactive for each website (static browser setup is answered in other questions)

elements.name: p-setup-2-process
elements.title: Process (during the visit of one URL of interest)

elements.name: 56-q-p2-process-1-bot
elements.title: Is something dynamic reported for bot evasion?
elements.description: e.g., filling captchas, realistic mouse movements

elements.name: 57-q-p2-process-2-crawlspecific
elements.title: Is the crawling/measurement generic for all sites or does it differ according to the site?

elements.name: 58-q-p2-process-3-pageload
elements.title: What is the page load timeout?
elements.commentPlaceholder: e.g., which page load event? (load, domcontentload, networkidle, ...)

elements.name: 60-q-p2-process-4-pagestay
elements.title: How long does the crawler stay on the page after the page loaded?

elements.name: 62-q-p2-process-5-pageinteraction
elements.title: Is there any webpage interaction mentioned?
elements.commentPlaceholder: E.g., explicit mention of no interaction

elements.name: 64-q-p2-process-7-datacollected
elements.title: What is measured/what data is collected?

elements.name: 65-66-q-p2-process-8-parallel-2
elements.title: Enter the number of parallel crawlers

elements.name: 67-q-p2-process-9-reqssecond
elements.title: How many requests are performed per second/site?

elements.name: 70-q-p2-crawlmultiple-2-multipledetails
elements.title: What was the purpose of the multiple crawls?

elements.name: 71-q-p2-analysis-1-exclusion
elements.title: Are any URLs excluded? (after crawling, during analysis)
elements.description: Not full sources of URLs reduced/changed, but filtering of URLs after retreiving all from the source
elements.commentText: Add details (e.g., definition of duplicated pages)

elements.name: 73-q-p3-problems-1-genreport
elements.title: What does the paper say about generalization/representativeness?

elements.name: 74-q-p3-problems-2-genown
elements.title: What do you think about the representativeness/generalization of the paper?

elements.name: 75-q-p3-problems-3-gendetails
elements.title: Details about what the paper says about generalization/representativeness

elements.name: 76-q-p3-factors-1-factors
elements.title: Does the paper mention that results could depend on the measurement setup/process?

elements.name: 78-q-p3-factors-3-factorscat
elements.title: Which factor categories are mentioned?
elements.otherPlaceholder: Did we really miss a top-level category?

elements.name: 80-q-p3-factors-5-implementation
elements.title: Which crawler implementation factors are mentioned?

elements.name: 81-q-p3-factors-6-env
elements.title: Which crawler environment factors are mentioned?

elements.name: 82-q-p3-factors-7-process
elements.title: Which crawling process/setup factors are mentioned?

elements.name: 85-q-p3-factortesting-1-testing
elements.title: Does the paper test for the impact/influence of any factor (for the measurement)?

elements.name: 87-q-p3-factortesting-3-core
elements.title: Is the testing of the factor a core contribution of the paper?

elements.name: 88-q-p4-practices-1-limitations
elements.title: Does the paper explicitly mention limitations? (of the paper itself, does not have to be crawl related)

elements.name: 91-q-p4-practices-4-ethics
elements.title: Does the paper explicitly mention ethics somewhere in the text? (or a subset such as responsible disclosure)

elements.name: 92-q-p4-practices-5-ethicsloc
elements.title: Where are ethics mentioned? (named paragraph ~ section)

elements.name: 94-q-p4-practices-6-5-avail
elements.title: Is there an availability 'section'/paragraph or similar?

elements.name: 95-q-p4-practices-7-code
elements.title: Is the code (for the web measurement/crawl) available?

elements.name: 96-q-p4-practices-8-data
elements.title: Is the data (for the web measurement/crawl) available?

elements.name: 99-q-p4-practices-11-artifact-eval
elements.title: Are the artifacts of the paper evaluated?
